summary: Implemented the window title feature in the repository, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and Tuple[ControlType, str] to ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatting entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod, which passes one two-item argument. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title). rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise. CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (assertions skipped on legacy Windows), test_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Verified by reading only; no test run was performed.
